notes.title: The Last Case of Benedict Fox: Definitive Edition Update is Coming!
notes.notes:
Dear Detectives,

We are thrilled to unveil that The Last Case of Benedict Fox: Definitive Edition is coming on March 26, 2024! The Definitive Editions brings new content and improvements. And all current players will receive the Definite Edition update at no extra cost.

[previewyoutube=QXhgPsbmIkE;full][/previewyoutube]
So what’s new that’s coming with the Definitive Edition? Well, first we’ve included the Limbo area, a new place in which you can test your combat skills. We’ve added new terrifying secrets and puzzles that are waiting to be solved in the Mansion. We’ve also worked hard to improve the combat, making it more fluid and dynamic and we enhanced the exploration too. Plus, we're excited to announce the inclusion of Brazilian Portuguese and Chinese (Simplified) languages in the game. And finally, for the very first time, The Last Case of Benedict Fox will be available to play on PlayStation 5. 

Mark March 26th in your calendars, detectives. It’s time to re-enter the world of Limbo.


Until next time, 

Your Plot Twist Team

notes.title: Patch 2 Live + 40% Off for Summer Sale
notes.notes:
Hello detectives,

We’ve been deep in Limbo and we’re ready to travel back to the mansion with new fixes for the game. Phase 2 of our roadmap is officially going live and it’s a big one! This patch is available now on PC and will be out soon on Xbox too.

Phase 2 Patch Updates:

 MNK remapping and customizable controller layout
 Revamped/smoother camera
 More responsive controls
 Remastered combat and animation system
 Faster melee and aiming mechanics
 Rebalanced enemies to match increase player speed
 Enhanced easy difficulty with quest markers
 UI and Map Markers for improved progress flow
 General UI improvements based on player feedback
 Overhauled piano puzzle with improved camera and updated UI
 Improved stability and performance
 Audio fixes
 Bug fixes

It’s also summer, and what better summer activity is there than diving deep into a Lovecraftian mystery? The Last Case of Benedict Fox game, soundtrack, and art book are all 40% off now through July 13th for the Steam Summer Sale!

We hope you continue to enjoy Benedict’s story. Keep your reviews and feedback coming!

As always,

Your Plot Twist Team

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2023360/The_Last_Case_of_Benedict_Fox/

notes.title: Game Patch 1 - Performance and Save Improvements
notes.notes:
Hello detectives, 

Thank you for all your support. We are reading (and whenever we can, responding to) your feedback! Keep it coming! We are working harder than ever to improve the game in all aspects. And this patch is just the beginning. 

This patch addresses:

Fix: Flashlight exploit failsafe (we love the persistence from you guys!)
Fix: Achievements fix
Fix: Ink and Bits and Pieces summary on the map adjusted
Improvement: Performance improvements
Improvement: Autosave frequency increased

In addition to other fixes, we’re also working on tackling the big tough stuff soon:

 Alternative controller layouts
 Map markers and piano puzzle difficulty rebalancing
 Mouse and keyboard remapping
 Brazillian Portuguese Localization (yes, we heard you!)
 Continued performance improvements


The Steam patch is up with Xbox and PC Game Pass following shortly. Thank you so much for playing! Keep that feedback coming in. We are dedicated to continuing to improve the game. This patch is just the start and we'll have more updates in the coming weeks!

Until next time, 

Your Plot Twist team

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/32125/The_Last_Case_of_Benedict_Fox_Deluxe_Edition/
